_note: EDIT ME. Viseme map for Aloy's mouth (Jarvis 111326, from Nimbus's research /workspace/board/notes/visemes-lipsync-111326.md). Chain: sound -> Oculus viseme (15) -> mouth frame 'shape' at 'level' (half or full). Kokoro demos use 'ipa' (timed phonemes from the timestamped Kokoro model); typed text uses 'letters' (rough English spelling rules). Change a shape or move a sound and reload: the page maps at play time, no rebuild. Frames: Cora's closed (= amused rest), slight, ah, oh, ee; TweakX's pbm (full only), fv, th, l, oo, sh (111326 v3). 'shapes' sets per-frame entry: 'direct' skips the half frame. The page blends between mouth frames (short crossfade) instead of snapping, per the note.
standard: Oculus/Meta 15 visemes (= MPEG-4 14 + sil), collapsed to the 5 existing frames; Rhubarb A-H+X column for reference

FF.art: ok v3: upper teeth on lower lip; fv-half is subtle (entry frame only)

TH.art: ok v3: th-full tongue at the teeth; th-half skipped (reads as F/V)

DD.art: near-neutral per note (T/D hard to see); slight half

nn.art: N stays near-neutral per Nimbus; L has its own entry 'L' below

E.art: ok-ish: EH/AE open, narrower than aa; ah half
